scope: Bounding box of empirical staged grasps with 5% padding (minimum 0.1 mrad yaw / 0.05 mm translation); continuous x includes interpolated grasps between the two actual modes.
nuisance: Roll/pitch/z and robot state are sampled jointly from 16 nearest bank contexts; yaw/x/y take sampled physical context values; fixture follows unchanged angle geometry. Joint rest transforms and actuator targets are preserved separately from their contact-loaded measured states.
grasp_attach_timing: Measured approach pose constrained before finger closure, explicit released rigid-grasp approximation
